name: pointable-context
description: Pointable Context fixture lookup with an inline Codex conversation widget and text fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Inline point lookup in the current Codex task.
interface.longDescription: Resolve a fixture entity, inspect its bounded source/revision/freshness detail in an inline MCP App beside the current Codex conversation, and explicitly ask the Agent about that exact referent without opening a browser. Text-only fallback remains available. Desktop selection companions and the separate App Server browser client are opt-in research harnesses, not the default product path or a DCPM/CWA dependency.

Resolve GOV-1 and show its detail as an inline Pointable Context Widget in this task.

Use the Pointable Context Workspace skill to bind this task to an explicit local workspace.
